region: Same union of original cup mask and rendered predicted cup support, dilated 7 px; matched nearest-8Hz frames at real 5Hz times
limitation: Region includes occlusion/background. Low warp error can still reward stationary objects; no identity or perceptual-quality proof.

real.method: Farneback backward RGB warp; forward-backward residual <1 px; in-bounds only
real.interpretation: Includes flow/occlusion errors; low error also rewards static video. Compare at matched times.
